name: sqlprojectreader-malformed-project-throws
body: Read reads each named .sqlproj with File.ReadAllText and parses it with ParseProject, unguarded, so a read or parse failure of one named project throws out of Read; SchemaEmitter.Run pre-parses each listed .sqlproj and drops a failing one with a sql: diagnostic before calling Read, so in the scan Read throws only if a project file changes or vanishes between those two reads. A .. Build Include that climbs above the repository root resolves to no repository path and matches no file without any report. Upgrade when Read takes already-parsed projects or catches per-project failures itself, and report an above-root include as a diagnostic if it must be visible.
